Definition: another form for G4084; to pack:--press down.
BiblicalUsage: Piezo means to press down, to pack tight. Jesus uses it once, in Luke 6:38: good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God measures back to givers the way He loves to be measured to — pressed down and running over.
